enrich.rationale: Residual-UCB active enrichment will concentrate new solves in the empirically high-error regions (those correlated inputs), maximizing RMSE reduction per added sample to close the remaining gap to target.

diagnosis: Generalization error is still primarily sample/coverage-limited in specific input directions (r0/a/kappa/delta/Ip) with stable CV splits, not dominated by tuning noise or a clear learning-curve plateau.
